title: Sport and Exercise Psychology with Dr Josephine Perry

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你能通过出卖时间赚钱之外，还能赚到更多的钱，会怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家马里安·特伦特博士，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动收入和循环收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一些令人兴奋的好消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many program is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特的“一对多”项目现在开放报名了。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可规模化的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己于2022年完成了这个项目，从那以后，我也支持了两届心理学家学员走过他们的心路历程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的推广链接加入，你将获得苏菲的额外福利以及我专属的支持套餐，无需支付额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四场小组智囊团会议、大师班、个性化指导、一份福特南·梅森的礼品，以及限时的一对一教练福利。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过简介中链接的我的福利页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的福利。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。

sentences.en: On today's episode, I'm joined by Dr. Josephine Perry, a qualified and regulated sport and exercise psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 在今天的节目中，我邀请到了合格且受监管的运动与健身心理学家约瑟芬·佩里博士。

sentences.en: The episode is going to be super useful for you, regardless of which area of psychology you are passionate about.
sentences.zh: 无论你对心理学的哪个领域充满热情，这期节目对你来说都超级有用。

sentences.en: There's loads of useful tips and guidance for performance and mindset.
sentences.zh: 这里有大量关于表现和心态的实用技巧与指导。

sentences.en: And if you stay tuned right to the end, you might find some interesting tips you've also not considered in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你一直收听到最后，你可能会发现一些以前从未考虑过的好玩技巧。

sentences.en: Hope you find it so useful.
sentences.zh: 希望你觉得它很有用。

sentences.en: It is slightly longer than usual.
sentences.zh: 它比平常稍微长一点。

sentences.en: It's about 45-50 minutes, but it's well worth every second.
sentences.zh: 大约45到50分钟，但绝对每一秒都物超所值。

sentences.en: Enjoy.
sentences.zh: 好好享受吧。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎收听“有抱负的心理学家”播客。

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent and I'm a qualified clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我是马里安·特伦特博士，我是一名合格的临床心理学家。

sentences.en: Today, we have a slightly longer than usual episode and we're going to be talking with Dr. Josephine Perry.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们有一期比平时稍长的节目，我们将与约瑟芬·佩里博士进行交谈。

sentences.en: She's incredibly inspiring to speak with and I feel really humbled and honoured that she gave us her time so freely.
sentences.zh: 与她交谈极其鼓舞人心，我觉得非常荣幸和谦卑，她如此慷慨地抽出时间给我们。

sentences.en: And it was such a pleasure to speak with her.
sentences.zh: 能与她交谈真是太愉快了。

sentences.en: I hope you'll find it useful.
sentences.zh: 希望你会觉得这期节目有用。

sentences.en: I'll look forward to catching up with you on the other side.
sentences.zh: 我期待在节目后与你交流。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to today's episode.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎收听今天的节目。

sentences.en: I'm really very excited to introduce you to Dr. Josephine Perry.
sentences.zh: 我非常高兴地向大家介绍约瑟芬·佩里博士。

sentences.en: Dr. Josephine is a sport and exercise psychologist and also an author.
sentences.zh: 约瑟芬博士是一位运动与健身心理学家，同时也是一位作家。

sentences.en: Welcome along, Josephine.
sentences.zh: 欢迎你，约瑟芬。

sentences.en: Oh, thank you for having me.
sentences.zh: 哦，谢谢你邀请我。

sentences.en: Thank you for saying yes.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你答应接受邀请。

sentences.en: I'm really excited to meet you, to get to know you and to help our audience learn more about you and your work, your books and your career.
sentences.zh: 我非常高兴能与你见面、了解你，并帮助我们的听众更多地了解你、你的工作、你的书和你的职业生涯。

sentences.en: So, what is a sport and exercise psychologist?
sentences.zh: 那么，什么是运动与健身心理学家？

sentences.en: Let's start there.
sentences.zh: 让我们从这里开始吧。

sentences.en: So, we are trained, I guess, officially in mental skills.
sentences.zh: 所以，我想我们是在心理技能方面受过官方训练的。

sentences.en: A lot of us now call ourselves performance psychologists because we don't just work in sport and exercise.
sentences.zh: 我们现在很多人称自己为表现心理学家，因为我们不仅在运动和健身领域工作。

sentences.en: I have clients who are medics, who are entrepreneurs, who are DJs, opera singers and lots of athletes.
sentences.zh: 我的客户包括医生、企业家、DJ、歌剧演员以及很多运动员。

sentences.en: And it is about helping someone get the absolute best out of themselves.
sentences.zh: 这就是要帮助一个人发挥出自己最好的状态。

sentences.en: So, that might be through workshops in clubs and I'll go into lots of sports clubs or work with sports scholars in schools.
sentences.zh: 这可能通过在俱乐部举办研讨会来实现，我会去很多运动俱乐部，或者与学校里的体育特长生合作。

sentences.en: To help teach some kind of general elements.
sentences.zh: 来帮助教授一些通用的要素。

sentences.en: We might be working on how to max out your motivation or how to handle performance anxiety.
sentences.zh: 我们可能在研究如何最大化你的动机，或者如何处理表现焦虑。

sentences.en: And then I also work one-on-one with people to really focus on their specific elements.
sentences.zh: 然后我也与人们进行一对一的合作，真正专注于他们的具体要素。

sentences.en: What might be holding them back from where they want to get to?
sentences.zh: 是什么在阻碍他们达到他们想去的地方？

sentences.en: How do they keep going?
sentences.zh: 他们是如何坚持下去的？

sentences.en: I work a lot in endurance sports and my background is endurance sports.
sentences.zh: 我在耐力运动领域工作很多，我的背景也是耐力运动。

sentences.en: So, I work a lot with people about how do you manage to do a hundred mile run?
sentences.zh: 所以我经常和人们一起探讨：你如何设法完成一百英里的跑步？

sentences.en: I've got some doing a hundred mile ultra this weekend.
sentences.zh: 我这周末就有人要完成一百英里的超级马拉松。

sentences.en: It's like, how do you keep going for a hundred miles when every part of your body is screaming no?
sentences.zh: 就像是，当你的身体每一部分都在尖叫着“不”的时候，你是如何坚持跑完一百英里的？

sentences.en: So, it's a complete mix of working with teams, helping the teams get better working together and those individuals within the teaMs.
sentences.zh: 所以，这完全是将与团队合作（帮助团队更好地协同工作）以及与团队中的这些个人合作相结合。

sentences.en: And then also working with individuals and helping them get the most out of themselves.
sentences.zh: 同时也是与个人合作，帮助他们发挥出最大的潜能。

sentences.en: Amazing.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: It sounds like a fascinating area and I'm intrigued to see how I get beyond three kilometres in a run, let alone a hundred miles.
sentences.zh: 这听起来是一个迷人的领域，我很好奇自己跑步怎么才能超过三公里，更不用说一百英里了。

sentences.en: So, hats off to your clients.
sentences.zh: 所以，向你的客户致敬。

sentences.en: That's, you know, really, really impressive stuff.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这真的是非常、非常令人印象深刻的事情。

sentences.en: How did you get into it?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么开始接触这一行的？

sentences.en: So, I had a previous career as a communications director and so until 2013, I was working for a company called, a charity actually called Nuffield Health,
sentences.zh: 我之前的职业是传讯总监，所以在2013年之前，我在一家名为“纳菲尔德健康”的公司（实际上是一家慈善机构）工作，

sentences.en: which was lovely because I was working in the fitness, the health world, but running communications, running campaigns to get people more active.
sentences.zh: 这很好，因为我在健身和健康世界工作，但我是负责传讯和开展活动以让人们更加活跃。

sentences.en: But, my heart was in Ironman racing,
sentences.zh: 但是，我的心一直在铁人三项比赛上，

sentences.en: so I was doing long distance triathlons with my husband and we went over to Australia to do Ironman Melbourne and I was standing on the beach in Frankston,
sentences.zh: 我和丈夫一起参加长距离铁人三项赛，我们去澳大利亚参加墨尔本铁人三项赛，我站在弗兰克斯顿的海滩上，

sentences.en: which is where the swim start is there and the waves looked horrific and I was really, really scared.
sentences.zh: 那是游泳起点所在地，海浪看起来太可怕了，我真的非常害怕。

sentences.en: And the guy on the tannoy said, you can't control those waves, you can only control how you feel about them.
sentences.zh: 扩音器里的那个家伙说，你无法控制那些海浪，你只能控制你对它们的感受。

sentences.en: And it was proper light bulb moment stuff of me going, ah, if I used my brain,
sentences.zh: 这真是一个彻头彻尾的“顿悟”时刻，我想，啊，如果我动动脑子，

sentences.en: I could be a lot better at this sports stuff because I was always the really geeky academic kid at school and I was always last out of the changing rooms to ever do any sports.
sentences.zh: 我在这些体育运动方面可能会做得更好，因为我在学校时一直是那个真正书呆子气的学术型孩子，而且我总是最后一个离开更衣室去参加任何体育活动的人。

sentences.en: And I suddenly realised I could be a lot better at sport if I actually used my brain a bit more.
sentences.zh: 我突然意识到，如果我真的多动点脑子，我在运动上可以表现得好得多。

sentences.en: And I got in the water and I did the swim and I had my fastest Ironman race, probably ever because I can't see me going back to it.
sentences.zh: 我跳进水里游了泳，并且完成了我可能有生以来最快的一次铁人三项比赛，因为我觉得我不会再回去了。

sentences.en: And when I got back to the UK afterwards, I really started looking into sports psychology.
sentences.zh: 后来回到英国后，我真正开始研究运动心理学。

sentences.en: And I think at the time there was probably only Steve Peter's book around the chimp paradox and there wasn't really that much else and there wasn't really much information on how to get into it.
sentences.zh: 我想当时周围大概只有史蒂夫·彼得斯的书《黑猩猩悖论》，除此之外真的没有太多其他东西，也没有太多关于如何进入这个领域的资料。

sentences.en: But I wasn't enjoying my job at all.
sentences.zh: 但是我一点也不喜欢我的工作。

sentences.en: And I had the ability to go and my husband said, well, just have a year off, have a gap year.
sentences.zh: 我有能力离开，我丈夫说，那就休假一年吧，去过个间隔年。

sentences.en: And I was like, yeah, I'll do that.
sentences.zh: 我说，好啊，我就这么办。

sentences.en: So I quit the job.
sentences.zh: 于是我辞掉了工作。

sentences.en: And and within two weeks I was bored.
sentences.zh: 两周内我就感到无聊了。

sentences.en: So I went to do a master's in psychology, a conversion course.
sentences.zh: 所以我去攻读心理学硕士学位，这是一个转专业课程。

sentences.en: And with the idea being that, well, that would always help understanding behaviour change.
sentences.zh: 当时的想法是，这总能有助于理解行为改变。

sentences.en: If you understand behaviour better, that's going to help me understand behaviour change.
sentences.zh: 如果你更好地理解行为，那将有助于我理解行为改变。

sentences.en: I can go straight back into communications.
sentences.zh: 我可以马上回到传讯行业。

sentences.en: It will be helpful.
sentences.zh: 这会有帮助的。

sentences.en: But with the idea that that maybe I could pick up the sports side, too.
sentences.zh: 但当时的的想法是，也许我也可以涉足体育领域。

sentences.en: And I enjoyed that.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢那个过程。

sentences.en: So I signed up for a master's in sport and exercise psychology.
sentences.zh: 所以我报名攻读了运动与健身心理学硕士学位。

sentences.en: It's usually a one year course.
sentences.zh: 这通常是一年的课程。

sentences.en: And then I discovered at the end of that, if you actually want to be a sport and exercise psychologist, it's another three years training.
sentences.zh: 然后我在结束时发现，如果你真的想成为一名运动与健身心理学家，还需要进行三年的培训。

sentences.en: I'm not sure I would have gone into it if I'd have properly done my research up front.
sentences.zh: 如果我事先做好充分的调查，我真不确定自己是否会涉足这一行。

sentences.en: But I was already halfway down the route by then.
sentences.zh: 但当时我已经走到半路了。

sentences.en: So you then find a supervisor.
sentences.zh: 所以你需要找一个导师。

sentences.en: And you sign up to the BPS to do kind of it's not really a training course.
sentences.zh: 你向英国心理学会（BPS）注册，这其实不是一个培训课程。

sentences.en: It's more like you are out working as a trainee sports psychologist, but you have lots of boxes to tick.
sentences.zh: 它更像是你作为见习运动心理学家在外面工作，但你有很多项目需要勾选完成。

sentences.en: You have many, many, many hours to show of the work that you've been doing.
sentences.zh: 你需要展示你一直在做的工作的很多、很多、很多个小时。

sentences.en: You have case studies to write.
sentences.zh: 你需要写案例研究。

sentences.en: You do a large research project that's the equivalent of a PhD level research project.
sentences.zh: 你要做一个相当于博士水平研究项目的大型研究课题。

sentences.en: And that takes most people around three years to do.
sentences.zh: 大多数人需要大约三年时间来完成这些。

sentences.en: OK, so unlike clinical psychology, for example, there's not the machine that's having a forward momentum as well and kind of keeping you on track.
sentences.zh: 好吧，所以不像临床心理学那样，有一个能够向前推进并让你保持在正轨上的机构机器。

sentences.en: It sounds like it's very much just driven by yourself.
sentences.zh: 听起来这完全是由你自己驱动的。

sentences.en: Totally.
sentences.zh: 完全如此。

sentences.en: So there are three routes you can take now, which has opened up since I did mine.
sentences.zh: 所以现在你可以选择三条路径，自我做的那会儿起这些路径就已经拓展了。

sentences.en: When I did it, it was purely what we call BPS stage two.
sentences.zh: 我做的时候，纯粹是我们所谓的BPS第二阶段。

sentences.en: It's called the QSEP.
sentences.zh: 它被称为QSEP。

sentences.en: There is another route that's through BASIS, which is often for people who've got more of a sport and exercise background rather than a psychology background.
sentences.zh: 还有另一条途径是通过BASIS，这通常适合那些具有更多运动与健身背景而不是心理学背景的人。

sentences.en: I don't know that much about it, but it feels like that one has much more handholding.
sentences.zh: 我对它了解不多，但感觉那条途径会有更多的手把手指导。

sentences.en: So there are workshops that you go to as part of it.
sentences.zh: 作为其中的一部分，你要去参加一些研讨会。

sentences.en: I don't think you have to do the research project, but a lot of it will be very similar.
sentences.zh: 我想你不必做研究项目，但很多内容会非常相似。

sentences.en: It's about building up hours of workshops and one to one work and communicating and explaining sports psychology processes.
sentences.zh: 这是关于积累研讨会和一对一工作的小时数，以及沟通和解释运动心理学流程。

sentences.en: And there is also another route that you can do called a professional doctorate.
sentences.zh: 还有另一条途径叫做职业博士学位。

sentences.en: And there's three universities where you would do a doctorate, but much more of a practical doctorate than you might otherwise do.
sentences.zh: 有三所大学你可以攻读博士学位，但这比你通常做的要务实得多。

sentences.en: And you do that training alongside it.
sentences.zh: 你在进行这项培训的同时也在进行实践。

sentences.en: So there's now three routes.
sentences.zh: 所以现在有三条途径。

sentences.en: But if you've got a psychology background, you're probably most likely to go through the BPS route.
sentences.zh: 但如果你有心理学背景，你很可能会走BPS这条途径。

sentences.en: But it's not.
sentences.zh: 但它不是那样的。

sentences.en: I was explaining to a trainee I was talking to today.
sentences.zh: 我今天在跟一个见习生交流时向他解释说。

sentences.en: It's not about following a curriculum and there's no classes to go to in any way and there's no structure.
sentences.zh: 它不是遵循课程大纲，没有任何形式的课程要上，也没有任何结构。

sentences.en: You create it.
sentences.zh: 这一切都是你自己创造的。

sentences.en: So to me, it feels incredibly difficult.
sentences.zh: 所以对我来说，这感觉极其困难。

sentences.en: However, when you come out the other side, you are in an amazing position to to be able to do what you need to do.
sentences.zh: 然而，当你从另一端走出来时，你处于一个绝佳的位置，能够做你需要做的事情。

sentences.en: So it forces you to stand on your own two feet and it forces you to make it work if it works.
sentences.zh: 所以它迫使你自立更生，如果可行的话，它迫使你让它发挥作用。

sentences.en: So if you make it through the process, you will be hopefully a really good sports psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果你经历了整个过程，希望你会成为一个非常优秀的运动心理学家。

sentences.en: Because you've practiced what you've preached, I guess.
sentences.zh: 因为我猜你践行了你所宣扬的理念。

sentences.en: But it feels like there is a niche in the market for someone having a more taught approach and a more formulaic approach that A plus B equals C plus D, you know,
sentences.zh: 但感觉市场上似乎存在一个空白，适合那些想要更偏向讲授的方法、更公式化的方法（比如A加B等于C加D）的人，

sentences.en: and that you come out at the end or do you not feel do you feel like this is part and parcel of becoming the sport and exercise psychologist?
sentences.zh: 然后你在最后毕业，或者你觉得不是这样？你觉得这是成为运动与健身心理学家不可或缺的一部分吗？

sentences.en: I actually think it is that part and parcel bit.
sentences.zh: 我实际上认为这就是不可或缺的一部分。

sentences.en: So when I was going through it, I was probably very critical about it and I can absolutely understand trainees frustrations.
sentences.zh: 所以当我经历这个过程时，我可能对它非常批判，我完全能理解见习生们的沮丧。

sentences.en: However, this is not an easy career to have.
sentences.zh: 然而，这不是一份轻松的职业。

sentences.en: There are not many jobs in sports psychology.
sentences.zh: 运动心理学的工作并不多。

sentences.en: I did actually write a blog post a few years ago trying to figure out how many roles there were.
sentences.zh: 几年前我确实写过一篇博客文章，试图弄清楚有多少个职位。

sentences.en: I would guess there's probably 100 employed roles as an applied sports psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我猜作为应用运动心理学家，大概有100个受雇岗位。

sentences.en: So there's maybe 20, 25 people that would work for it's just changed its name.
sentences.zh: 所以可能还有20、25人受雇于——它刚刚改了名字。

sentences.en: It used to be the English Institute of Sport and I think they've become UK based now and they work in the national governing bodies.
sentences.zh: 它以前叫英格兰体育学院，我想他们现在已经变成英国本土机构了，他们在国家管理机构工作。

sentences.en: So you might then work for British athletics and you would be the sports site for British athletics.
sentences.zh: 所以你可能会为英国田径协会工作，你将成为英国田径协会的运动心理专家。

sentences.en: It's not something like 20, 25 people there.
sentences.zh: 那里大概没有20、25个人那么多的职位。

sentences.en: Then you have people that work in, say, the main football clubs, premiership clubs, rugby clubs, cricket clubs.
sentences.zh: 然后有人在例如主要的足球俱乐部、英超俱乐部、橄榄球俱乐部、板球俱乐部工作。

sentences.en: And then you might have some people that work for TAS, which is kind of a talented athlete scheme that goes on within universities.
sentences.zh: 然后你可能有一些人为TAS工作，这是一种在大学里进行的优秀运动员计划。

sentences.en: That's it for like having an employed job where that is all you do and someone pays your salary.
sentences.zh: 这就是所有全职受雇且别人给你发薪水的工作了。

sentences.en: Many others are working in universities, teaching sports psychology in some way, and they will see some athletes on the side.
sentences.zh: 许多其他人则在大学里工作，以某种方式教授运动心理学，他们会顺便接待一些运动员。

sentences.en: And then the rest of us, there's three or four companies that take on sports psychologists.
sentences.zh: 其余的我们，有三四家公司会雇用运动心理学家。

sentences.en: They do performance work, usually in corporate worlds, actually.
sentences.zh: 他们从事表现工作，通常实际上是在企业界。

sentences.en: So they'll often be working either in schools doing teaching or they'll work with big corporates, but they'll be coming from the sports angle.
sentences.zh: 所以他们经常要么在学校里教书，要么与大企业合作，但他们会从体育的角度切入。

sentences.en: And the rest of us will run our own private practices.
sentences.zh: 而我们其余的人则经营自己的私人诊所。

sentences.en: And so there are probably hundreds of people coming out of masters in sport and exercise psychology courses who need to decide.
sentences.zh: 因此，每年可能有数百人从运动与健身心理学硕士课程中毕业，他们需要做出决定。

sentences.en: Can they handle the fact they might basically be running their own business?
sentences.zh: 他们能否接受自己基本上要经营自己的生意这一事实？

sentences.en: Where are they going to go out and look for that work from?
sentences.zh: 他们要到哪里去寻找这些工作？

sentences.en: So some may be very lucky and get into a paid role, but I have to say the paid roles don't pay very much.
sentences.zh: 所以有些人可能会非常幸运地进入一个带薪职位，但我必须说带薪职位薪水不高。

sentences.en: I've seen some, I've seen some roles in premiership clubs advertised at around £20,000 a year for someone that's got seven years of training.
sentences.zh: 我见过一些英超俱乐部的职位广告，对于一个接受过七年培训的人来说，年薪大约是2万英镑。

sentences.en: So.
sentences.zh: 所以。

sentences.en: And for someone that's got the potential to make them vast amounts of money.
sentences.zh: 而对于一个有潜力为他们赚取巨额财富的人来说。

sentences.en: Amazing, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 太惊人了，对吧？

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And their arguments are, but someone will do it.
sentences.zh: 他们的论点是，总有人会去做的。

sentences.en: So we can get away with it.
sentences.zh: 所以我们就能蒙混过关。

sentences.en: But if you want to make a decent living, you are probably going to have to be in applied practice, private practice on your own.
sentences.zh: 但如果你想过上正经的生活，你可能不得不靠自己从事应用实践和私人诊所。

sentences.en: And I think that means actually the training is probably right for that because you are having to figure out how to make it work.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为这实际上意味着，这种培训可能非常适合这一点，因为你必须弄清楚如何让它发挥作用。

sentences.en: You are having to connect with others.
sentences.zh: 你必须与他人建立联系。

sentences.en: You are having to network.
sentences.zh: 你必须进行社交网络拓展。

sentences.en: And although it's then a really small sector and it feels like it should be very competitive, most of the time it's incredibly friendly and we're all send referrals to each other.
sentences.zh: 尽管它是一个非常小的行业，而且看起来应该竞争非常激烈，但大多数时候它极其友好，我们都会互相转介客户。

sentences.en: So if there's something I can't do, I've got many other people I can send it on to.
sentences.zh: 所以如果有我做不了的事情，我有很多其他人可以转介过去。

sentences.en: There's certain groups I don't really work with anymore because I'm not going to be a great psychologist for a 12 year old footballer.
sentences.zh: 有些群体我不再真正合作了，因为我对一个12岁的足球运动员来说不会是一个出色的心理学家。

sentences.en: I'm basically their mum and they don't want to hear from their mum.
sentences.zh: 我基本上就是他们的妈妈，而他们不想听妈妈的话。

sentences.en: So there'll be other people that I send on to and people that refer in to me and other psychologists that I'll make connections with and we'll do work together.
sentences.zh: 所以会有我转介过去的人，也有转介给我的人，以及我将建立联系的其他心理学家，我们会一起合作。

sentences.en: And so it's really friendly and really helpful.
sentences.zh: 所以这真的很友好，也真的很有帮助。

sentences.en: But that networking and those contacts are really, really important.
sentences.zh: 但这种社交网络和这些联系真的非常非常重要。

sentences.en: And so I think it's really important that actually the training reflects that.
sentences.zh: 因此我认为，培训能够真实反映这一点真的非常重要。

sentences.en: You need to go out and find clients.
sentences.zh: 你需要走出去寻找客户。

sentences.en: You need to work out how to market yourself.
sentences.zh: 你需要研究如何把自己推销出去。

sentences.en: You're not going to be given very unlikely a role.
sentences.zh: 你不太可能会被直接分配到一个角色。

sentences.en: And when you train, the BPS often suggests that you can go into a placement to do your training.
sentences.zh: 当你在接受培训时，BPS经常建议你可以去实习来完成培训。

sentences.en: And yet when I've asked, I put a little poll out on Twitter and 3% of people had a placement.
sentences.zh: 然而当我询问时，我在推特上发起了一个小投票，只有3%的人有过实习经历。

sentences.en: Everybody else was finding a way to do it on their own.
sentences.zh: 其他所有人都在自己想办法完成它。

sentences.en: And so I think the training needs to reflect that.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为培训需要反映这一现实。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全同意。

sentences.en: And is there is there a cohort at all?
sentences.zh: 而且这里面有同期学员吗？

sentences.en: Are you sort of being taken on individually throughout a year or throughout, you know, throughout the talk program?
sentences.zh: 你们是在一年中或者你知道的，在整个授课项目的过程中，是陆陆续续被个别招收的吗？

sentences.en: So BASYS has two cohorts a year, I think.
sentences.zh: 所以BASYS每年大概有两个同期班级。

sentences.en: So then you have more of that feeling that you're with other people and you get to share that experience, which I think is really helpful.
sentences.zh: 所以那样的话，你会更有那种和其他人在一起的感觉，并且能够分享这种经历，我认为这真的很有帮助。

sentences.en: On the BPS route, you just sign up and register when you're ready to do so.
sentences.zh: 在BPS的途径中，只要你准备好了，就可以直接报名注册。

sentences.en: So you don't have that cohort in the same way.
sentences.zh: 所以你没有那种传统意义上的同期学员。

sentences.en: But some people might well share the supervisor.
sentences.zh: 但有些人很可能会共享同一个导师。

sentences.en: And certainly when I supervise people, I have a group where they talk and they engage and you start to build up those contacts.
sentences.zh: 而且当然，自我指导学员时，我有一个小组，他们在里面交流、互动，然后你开始建立这些联系。

sentences.en: I have a peer supervision group that I'm on where there's 12 of us who've all been qualified about the same time.
sentences.zh: 我参加过一个同行督导小组，里面有12个人，我们都是差不多同一时间获得资格的。

sentences.en: And we will use that to find somebody else that might be able to help if there's a difficult situation going on or to be able to get research papers if you need them.
sentences.zh: 如果遇到困难情况，我们可以通过它来寻找能够提供帮助的人，或者在需要时获取研究论文。

sentences.en: So that's one of the other problems is that we're not within organisations most of the time.
sentences.zh: 所以这是另一个问题，那就是我们大多数时候并不在组织内部工作。

sentences.en: And when you do the training, you're not within a university doing the training.
sentences.zh: 而且当你进行培训时，你也不是在大学里进行培训。

sentences.en: And yet all the evidence you put forward in order to qualify must be evidence based.
sentences.zh: 然而你为了获得资格而提出的所有证据都必须是基于证据的。

sentences.en: And so you need the literature, but there is no way to get the literature.
sentences.zh: 所以你需要文献，但却没有途径获取文献。

sentences.en: So finding these kind of ways around it and being in groups and working with other people really helps you to find what you need.
sentences.zh: 因此，找到这些应对方法、加入小组并与其他人合作，真的能帮助你找到你需要的东西。

sentences.en: Sounds very stressful and frustrating.
sentences.zh: 听起来压力很大，也很令人沮丧。

sentences.en: Yes, very.
sentences.zh: 是的，非常大。

sentences.en: Amazing.
sentences.zh: 太厉害了。

sentences.en: I don't know how you've done it.
sentences.zh: 我不知道你是怎么坚持下来的。

sentences.en: Like hats off to you, hats off to you.
sentences.zh: 真的是向你致敬，向你致敬。

sentences.en: And you said there that, you know, with the BPS route that you sort of apply when you're ready.
sentences.zh: 你刚才提到，你知道的，通过BPS途径，你是准备好时就去申请的。

sentences.en: That makes it sound like anybody can do it, but I'm sure that's not the case at all.
sentences.zh: 这听起来好像任何人都可以做到，但我确信事实绝非如此。

sentences.en: What are the essential or minimum requirements?
sentences.zh: 核心或最低要求是什么？

sentences.en: So you need to have a graduate basis for BPS membership and you have to have stage one.
sentences.zh: 你需要具备BPS会员资格的毕业生基础，并且你必须拥有第一阶段资格。

sentences.en: And stage one is a master's in sport and exercise psychology that is accredited.
sentences.zh: 第一阶段是获得认证的运动与运动心理学硕士学位。

sentences.en: Then you also need an enhanced DBS check and you need to know that you will show that you've got insurance.
sentences.zh: 然后你还需要一份增强型DBS背景调查，并且你需要证明你拥有保险。

sentences.en: And then you need two references from qualified sports psychologists.
sentences.zh: 接着你需要两封来自合格运动心理学家的推荐信。

sentences.en: So it does take quite a lot of information to pull together.
sentences.zh: 所以这确实需要搜集相当多的信息。

sentences.en: And alongside that, you also need to write your own plan of work.
sentences.zh: 在此之外，你还需要撰写你自己的工作计划。

sentences.en: And that is a significant piece of work to figure out how are you going to do 2,000 hours of one-to-one work?
sentences.zh: 这是一项意义重大的工作，要弄清楚你将如何完成2000小时的一对一工作？

sentences.en: How are you going to do 2,000 hours of research?
sentences.zh: 你将如何完成2000小时的研究？

sentences.en: It's about 400 hours, I think, of dissemination, of CPD, of ethics work.
sentences.zh: 我想大约还有400小时的成果普及、CPD（持续专业发展）、职业道德方面的工作。

sentences.en: But it's chunky at the time to do, but it's really helpful for thinking about how do I go out and get what I need?
sentences.zh: 但当时做起来确实挺繁重的，不过对于思考“我该如何走出去并获得我需要的东西？”真的很有帮助。

sentences.en: And how do I try and make some money at the same time?
sentences.zh: 以及我该如何同时尝试赚点钱？

sentences.en: Yeah, and actually that's, I think it makes it more formulaic and it makes you know which, you know, which hoops you need to jump through.
sentences.zh: 是的，而且实际上这我认为它让过程更有公式化，让你清楚知道你需要跨越哪些门槛。

sentences.en: And I guess for anyone in any area of psychology, it might be helpful to think about that, you know.
sentences.zh: 我想对于心理学任何领域的任何人来说，思考这一点可能会有所帮助。

sentences.en: So even if they're working, for example, in an assistant psychologist route, I think I haven't got time for research.
sentences.zh: 所以即使他们例如在走助理心理学家的路线，我也会想：我没有时间做研究。

sentences.en: Well, actually, if you committed to yourself to think, well, I've got to do 100 hours this year of research-based stuff, how are you going to do that?
sentences.zh: 然而实际上，如果你对自己承诺，认为“我今年必须完成100小时基于研究的事情”，你打算怎么做？

sentences.en: That's a really interesting and potentially useful idea.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常有趣且可能很有用的想法。

sentences.en: Yeah, and I would really advise anyone starting this process, when you think about the research bit, because it's so substantial,
sentences.zh: 是的，我真的会建议任何开始这个过程的人，当你考虑研究部分时，因为它太庞大了，

sentences.en: and I certainly, I felt like I was sulking a bit while I did a lot of it, because I already had a PhD.
sentences.zh: 而且我当然，在做很多这方面工作时我感觉自己有点在生闷气，因为我已经拥有博士学位了。

sentences.en: And I was then being made to do 2,000 hours of research, when I've already got a higher qualification.
sentences.zh: 而当我本已拥有更高学位时，却被迫去做2000小时的研究。

sentences.en: I was definitely not in a great place about doing it.
sentences.zh: 我对做这件事的心情绝对算不上好。

sentences.en: But if you can think about what you would like your specialism to be, that's really helpful.
sentences.zh: 但如果你能思考你希望自己的专长是什么，那会非常有用。

sentences.en: So I think it's really important when you're looking at the hours you do training, you get a really good range.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为当你审视培训时长时，获得非常广泛的涉猎真的很重要。

sentences.en: So there's certain sports I don't particularly like working in, there's certain groups that I'm not going to be brilliant with.
sentences.zh: 所以有些运动我不太喜欢涉足，有些群体我可能并不擅长应付。

sentences.en: But you need to know that.
sentences.zh: 但你需要了解这一点。

sentences.en: You need to get a really wide range of age groups, of both sexes, of all the different sports.
sentences.zh: 你需要接触非常广泛的年龄段、不同的性别以及所有不同的运动项目。

sentences.en: I think I've worked in 27 sports now.
sentences.zh: 我想我现在已经在27个运动项目中工作过了。

sentences.en: And that's really helpful for them going, which ones do I actually like?
sentences.zh: 这对于他们思考“我到底喜欢哪几个？”真的很有帮助。

sentences.en: Which ones are good?
sentences.zh: “哪几个比较好？”

sentences.en: Which ones suit the way that I work?
sentences.zh: “哪几个适合我的工作方式？”

sentences.en: Really understanding all of that.
sentences.zh: 真正理解所有这些。

sentences.en: But when you've done a little bit of that, to then be able to go, I think I might want to specialise in this area.
sentences.zh: 但当你做了一点这样的尝试后，就能进而说：我想我可能想专注于这个领域。

sentences.en: So if I've got to do a research project, I'm going to make it something that's worthwhile.
sentences.zh: 所以如果我必须做一个研究项目，我要把它做得有价值。

sentences.en: And if you can make it in something that almost ends up as a product for you, or the thing that makes you stand out, that's really beneficial.
sentences.zh: 如果你能把它做成某种最终能成为你的产品，或者能让你脱颖而出的东西，那就太有益了。

sentences.en: So I did mine in exercise addiction and technology, and whether the use, the more you use technology, whether it influences your risk of exercise addiction in ultra athletes.
sentences.zh: 所以我把我的研究方向定在运动成瘾和科技上，探讨使用科技的程度是否会影响超级耐力运动员患运动成瘾的风险。

sentences.en: And I still use a lot of what I learnt today, and it has been incredibly helpful for making that a specialism of mine.
sentences.zh: 直到今天我仍然在使用我当时学到的大量知识，这对于将之打造成我的专业特长起到了极其巨大的帮助。

sentences.en: So on reflection, I think it is very helpful.
sentences.zh: 所以回想起来，我认为这真的很有帮助。

sentences.en: It's just frustrating at the time, but it's totally worth really diving in depth to a subject that might well shape your practice overall.
sentences.zh: 虽然当时令人沮丧，但完全值得深入钻研一个很可能会塑造你整体执业生涯的课题。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And I think with hindsight, I might well have picked a different area for my research than I ultimately did, because mine was in physical health.
sentences.zh: 我想事后看来，我的研究领域可能不会选择最终选定的那个，因为我研究的是身体健康。

sentences.en: And actually, that's probably not an area that I work in at all.
sentences.zh: 而实际上，那可能根本不是我工作的领域。

sentences.en: But I think because a lot of my postgraduate experiences before I got onto the doctorate were physical health, that sort of, that was my interest at the time.
sentences.zh: 但我想，由于我在攻读博士学位之前的大量研究生经历都与身体健康相关，所以那种兴趣在当时自然而然就形成了。

sentences.en: But it certainly wasn't my interest by the time I finished.
sentences.zh: 不过到我完成时，它绝对已经不再是我的兴趣所在了。

sentences.en: Hearing you talk about assisted tech, I work and have written in the media about orthorexia, which is where you're using, you know,
sentences.zh: 听你谈论辅助科技，我曾在媒体上就进食障碍（如健康食迷症）进行过工作和撰文，也就是你使用，你知道的，

sentences.en: you're forcing yourself to jump through different milestones.
sentences.zh: 你强迫自己去完成不同的里程碑。

sentences.en: And you might be using fitness tech to kind of keep yourself happy and feel like you've attained or achieved.
sentences.zh: 你可能在使用健身科技来让自己保持快乐，并觉得你已经达成或实现了目标。

sentences.en: And I have a Fitbit is hidden under this thing because I've broken my arm at the moment.
sentences.zh: 我这东西下面藏着一个Fitbit，因为我最近手臂骨折了。

sentences.en: And even being able to look at how many steps I've done is tricky because I can't twist my arm.
sentences.zh: 甚至连查看自己走了多少步都很棘手，因为我无法扭转手臂。

sentences.en: But I don't know if you know, but recently Fitbit did away with all of their challenges.
sentences.zh: 但不知道你知不知道，最近Fitbit取消了所有的挑战功能。

sentences.en: So Fitbit bingo is now scrapped fit and work, weak, hustle.
sentences.zh: 所以Fitbit连连看现在被废弃了，还有健身周冲刺。

sentences.en: You can no longer compete against people.
sentences.zh: 你不能再和别人竞争了。

sentences.en: And for me, that was one of the main appeals of Fitbit.
sentences.zh: 对我和来说，那是Fitbit的主要吸引力之一。

sentences.en: So I'm thinking about getting rid of it, to be honeSt.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我在考虑把它扔掉了。

sentences.en: You know, but there's this competitive ethos, even within wearing, you know, me and some of my psychology colleagues and friends I went to school with, you know,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，但这种竞争精神，甚至在使用设备时也存在，比如我和我的一些心理学同事以及上学时的朋友，你知道的，

sentences.en: trying to be a bit steppier than the other.
sentences.zh: 都试图比对方步数更多一点。

sentences.en: But orthorexia and fit tech can become more problematic than that, can't it?
sentences.zh: 但健康食迷症和健身科技会变得比这更具问题性，对吧？

sentences.en: It's a really tricky area and the whole area around any elements of disordered eating and over-exercising.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常棘手的领域，特别是围绕任何形式的饮食失调和过度运动的整个领域。

sentences.en: Because probably for 70% of the population need to probably eat healthier and move more.
sentences.zh: 因为可能对于70%的人口来说，确实需要吃得更健康、多活动。

sentences.en: And there are some policy elements that have been put in place that support that.
sentences.zh: 并且已经出台了一些支持这一目标的政策要素。

sentences.en: So calories on menus.
sentences.zh: 比如菜单上的热量标注。

sentences.en: There is research that shows for those who are likely to be overeating, that is incredibly helpful.
sentences.zh: 有研究表明，对于那些容易暴饮暴食的人来说，这极其有帮助。

sentences.en: And I certainly know I will look and I will make different choices based on what I see.
sentences.zh: 而且我当然知道我会看，并且会根据我看到的内容做出不同的选择。

sentences.en: So for that group of people, calories on a menu are helpful and help with that decision-making, the nudge process.
sentences.zh: 所以对那部分人群来说，菜单上的热量是有帮助的，有助于他们的决策过程，即助推机制。

sentences.en: For those who've had an eating disorder, they are really, really dangerous.
sentences.zh: 但对于那些曾经患有进食障碍的人来说，它们真的、真的很危险。

sentences.en: It is an absolute prompt to get you back into that eating disorder mindset.
sentences.zh: 这绝对是一个诱因，会把你重新拉回那种进食障碍的心态中。

sentences.en: And that eating disorder voice in your head will use the calories, it seems, to totally, totally beat you up.
sentences.zh: 你脑海中那个进食障碍的声音似乎会利用这些热量，彻底地、彻底地把你击垮。

sentences.en: And it's a horrible place to be.
sentences.zh: 那是一种糟糕透顶的境地。

sentences.en: Similarly, with all the information you can get off your phone or your Fitbit, for some people to be a bit steppier than the others, really good.
sentences.zh: 同样，通过手机或Fitbit获取的所有信息，对某些人来说，比别人步数多一点真的很好。

sentences.en: To get the feedback can be very helpful.
sentences.zh: 获得反馈会非常有帮助。

sentences.en: For others, really dangerous.
sentences.zh: 但对其他人来说，则非常危险。

sentences.en: And so there is this real mismatch between who uses what.
sentences.zh: 因此，在谁使用什么之间存在着这种真实的错位。

sentences.en: And I will often advise my athletes not to use things like Strava.
sentences.zh: 我经常会建议我的运动员不要使用Strava之类的东西。

sentences.en: Because, and I've really found this when I did that research, that I work from an approach called ACT, acceptance and commitment theory.
sentences.zh: 因为——我在做那项研究时对此深有体会——我是从一种叫做ACT（接纳承诺疗法）的方法出发开展工作的。

sentences.en: And one of the elements I love in it is values.
sentences.zh: 我非常喜欢其中的一个要素就是价值观。

sentences.en: It helps you work out what actually matters to you, not the things that are just easy to measure.
sentences.zh: 它能帮你弄清楚什么对你来说才是真正重要的，而不是那些仅仅容易被测量的事物。

sentences.en: And our watch is never going to tell us what actually matters.
sentences.zh: 我们的手表永远不会告诉我们什么才是真正重要的。

sentences.en: Our watch will tell us what's easy to measure.
sentences.zh: 我们的手表只会告诉我们什么很容易测量。

sentences.en: And so we end up validating ourselves and justifying and thinking whether we're a good or bad person based on some measurements on our watch.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们最终根据手表上的一些测量数据来肯定自己、证明自己，并以此判断自己是好人还是坏人。

sentences.en: Not, did I enjoy that run?
sentences.zh: 而不是去想：我享受那次跑步吗？

sentences.en: Did I catch up with my friend who's been really miserable and now feels a lot better because we went for a run together?
sentences.zh: 我有没有去关照我那位一直很不开心、但现在因为我们一起去跑步而感觉好多了的朋友？

sentences.en: And so I'll often ask athletes to go for naked exercise with no tech.
sentences.zh: 所以我经常会要求运动员进行不带任何科技设备的“纯净运动”。

sentences.en: They're allowed to wear their clothes.
sentences.zh: 他们被允许穿衣服。

sentences.en: But I want them to do stuff with no tech.
sentences.zh: 但我希望他们进行没有任何科技干扰的活动。

sentences.en: I really want them to think about how do they motivate themselves?
sentences.zh: 我真的希望他们思考自己是如何激励自己的？

sentences.en: How do they enjoy it when it's not to do with what times or distance or even how many goals they've scored?
sentences.zh: 当它与时间、距离甚至进球数无关时，他们是如何享受其中的？

sentences.en: And I do tend to work with a very specific group of athletes who all have performance anxiety.
sentences.zh: 我确实倾向于与一个非常特定群体的运动员合作，他们都有表现焦虑。

sentences.en: And they all have two traits in common.
sentences.zh: 他们都有两个共同的特征。

sentences.en: They're very intelligent and they're perfectionistic.
sentences.zh: 他们非常聪明，而且有完美主义倾向。

sentences.en: I call them VIPs.
sentences.zh: 我称他们为VIP。

sentences.en: And that perfectionism element means they're constantly trying to beat their watch or beat their friend on Strava.
sentences.zh: 这种完美主义倾向意味着他们不断地试图战胜自己的手表，或者战胜Strava上的朋友。

sentences.en: And it just becomes a really big hammer to beat themselves up with rather than remembering, why do I do this?
sentences.zh: 这最终成了一把狠狠击碎他们内心的重锤，而不是让他们去回想：我为什么要这样做？

sentences.en: I do it because I enjoy it.
sentences.zh: 我这样做是因为我享受它。

sentences.en: I do it because I want to feel fit and healthy.
sentences.zh: 我这样做是因为我想感觉身材健美、身体健康。

sentences.en: I did a workshop with a school on Wednesday night and we talked about motivation.
sentences.zh: 周三晚上我和一所学校做了一个工作坊，我们讨论了动力。

sentences.en: It was so lovely because we were filling in post-it notes and sticking them all over the place of different elements of motivation.
sentences.zh: 那真是太美妙了，因为我们在便签纸上写下不同动机的要素，并把它们贴得到处都是。

sentences.en: And I just love how I feel when I achieve a new skill.
sentences.zh: 我就是喜欢当我掌握一项新技能时的那种感觉。

sentences.en: I love how I feel when I've worked really hard for an hour.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢我努力工作一个小时后的那种感觉。

sentences.en: Nothing that they came up with was, I like knowing I've done my 10,000 steps a day.
sentences.zh: 他们提出的内容里没有任何一条是：“我喜欢知道自己每天完成了10,000步。”

sentences.en: So I can absolutely see why challenges and calories and all that other stuff can be helpful for some people.
sentences.zh: 所以我完全理解为什么挑战、热量和其他所有这些东西对某些人来说会有帮助。

sentences.en: But for people that are already diligent and dedicated to their sport and exercise, they can be incredibly harmful and they can rip all the joy out of what they do.
sentences.zh: 但对于那些已经对自己的运动和锻炼勤奋且专注的人来说，它们可能具有极大的破坏性，并会剥夺他们所做事情的所有乐趣。

sentences.en: And I don't have an answer because I don't know how you block some people from seeing things.
sentences.zh: 我也没有答案，因为我不知道该如何阻止某些人看到这些东西。

sentences.en: But I think it's really helpful for people to have the self-awareness of I am doing this.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，让人们具备这样的自我觉察能力真的很有帮助：我正在这样做。

sentences.en: Is it helpful for me?
sentences.zh: 这对我有帮助吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I hear you.
sentences.zh: 是的，我懂你的意思。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全同意。

sentences.en: It's really incredible and insightful, thoughtful points that you've raised there.
sentences.zh: 你提出的这些观点真的非常不可思议、很有见地且深思熟虑。

sentences.en: And it's interesting when I was listening to you and reflecting that initially when I first started going weight training, I would tell my watch afterwards that I'd done it.
sentences.zh: 而且有趣的是，当我听你说话并反思时，我发现刚开始进行力量训练时，我会在事后告诉手表我已经完成了。

sentences.en: I'd be like, amazing.
sentences.zh: 我会觉得：太棒了。

sentences.en: 45 minutes exercise, cleverly, well done.
sentences.zh: 45分钟的锻炼，很巧妙，干得漂亮。

sentences.en: But over time, because it was fiddly to do and a faff and my watch didn't automatically recognise that as exercise because it wasn't, you know, hardcore enough.
sentences.zh: 但随着时间推移，因为这很繁琐、很麻烦，而且我的手表并没有自动将其识别为锻炼，因为你知道，强度不够大。

sentences.en: I just didn't bother doing it, but I never bothered.
sentences.zh: 我干脆就不去做了，也从来没去管它。

sentences.en: But I still loved doing it.
sentences.zh: 但我依然很喜欢运动。

sentences.en: You know, I loved connecting with my personal trainer.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我很喜欢和我的私人教练交流。

sentences.en: Well, I'm going to love doing it when I can lift weights again.
sentences.zh: 嗯，等我以后能重新举铁时，我一定会很乐意去做的。

sentences.en: But, you know, I was gaining so much more than I ever would have gained from my Fitbit thinking that would have been quite cool.
sentences.zh: 但你知道的，相比于Fitbit认为这挺酷所带来的收获，我从中学到了远比这多得多的东西。

sentences.en: Yeah, I did an experiment a couple of years ago for I write some features for Cycling Weekly and Garmin gave me their very best model and I followed their training for a month.
sentences.zh: 对，几年前我做过一个实验，因为我为《自行车周刊》写一些专栏，佳明给了我他们最好的型号，我跟着他们的训练计划训练了一个月。

sentences.en: And then I followed my coach's training for a month.
sentences.zh: 然后我跟着我教练的训练计划训练了一个月。

sentences.en: And actually, what was really interesting was it was very similar and I would still get my coach's training even when I'm following the watch.
sentences.zh: 事实上，非常有趣的一点是，它们的训练非常相似，甚至当我跟着手表训练时，我依然能得到教练的训练安排。

sentences.en: And some days they would be identical.
sentences.zh: 有时甚至完全一模一样。

sentences.en: But I got so much more from having a coach.
sentences.zh: 但拥有教练让我收获了更多。

sentences.en: I got that connection.
sentences.zh: 我得到了那种连接。

sentences.en: I got the feedback.
sentences.zh: 我得到了反馈。

sentences.en: I got the chatting through things.
sentences.zh: 我得到了通过沟通解决问题的过程。

sentences.en: I got the understanding that I was having a really tough week work-wise and I had so much going on.
sentences.zh: 我得到了这样的理解：这周我的工作压力非常大，事情实在太多了。

sentences.en: And there was no point me going out to do a two-hour run on a Sunday because my body just wouldn't be able to take in that training.
sentences.zh: 周日根本没必要出门进行两小时的跑步，因为我的身体根本无法吸收那样的训练量。

sentences.en: It was going to push against and very likely I would probably get injured or ill.
sentences.zh: 这会产生对抗，而且很可能会让我受伤或生病。

sentences.en: And so there is so much more you can get from a person than you are going to get from a watch feeding you things.
sentences.zh: 因此，从一个人身上你能获得的，远比从一块向你灌输各种数据的手表上获得的要多得多。

sentences.en: There is for sure.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And sometimes some of the clients I work with who might still be in full-time education, for example,
sentences.zh: 有时候，我合作的一些客户，比如可能还在全日制学校学习的人，

sentences.en: and enjoying exercise and looking ahead to successful athletes are really reluctant to have any sort of academic coaching because they see that as cheating.
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢运动，并且对成为成功的运动员充满期待，却非常排斥任何形式的学业辅导，因为他们觉得那是作弊。

sentences.en: But yet can get on board with the fact that athletes would have coaches, but they can't feel that that's okay for them to almost get a bit of extra help with their academia.
sentences.zh: 然而，他们能接受运动员配有教练这一事实，却觉得自己在学业上稍微获得一点额外帮助是不行的。

sentences.en: How can people think around that?
sentences.zh: 人们怎么会产生这种思维逻辑呢？

sentences.en: I guess I only see the people that come to me and they're coming for performance coaching.
sentences.zh: 我想我接触到的都是来找我做表现教练的人。

sentences.en: And I get a lot of parents that will be saying, can you work with my child on their sports?
sentences.zh: 我有很多家长会说，你能帮我孩子训练体育吗？

sentences.en: Can you sneak in some stuff around exam stress?
sentences.zh: 能顺便聊聊怎么应对考试压力吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 可以。

sentences.en: And I know the next month, every under 18 that I work with, we won't really be doing much on the sports side.
sentences.zh: 我知道在接下来的一个月里，我合作的每一位18岁以下的年轻人，我们其实都不会把重点放在体育上。

sentences.en: We will be doing it on the exam side.
sentences.zh: 我们会把重点放在考试上。

sentences.en: But the techniques are identical.
sentences.zh: 但这些技巧是完全一样的。

sentences.en: So the technique I would use with an athlete or someone going through exams or a senior eye surgeon trying to do a really, really tricky operation that's coming up.
sentences.zh: 所以我用在运动员、面临考试的学生，或者即将主刀一台非常非常棘手手术的高级眼科医生身上的技巧。

sentences.en: They're identical.
sentences.zh: 它们都是一样的。

sentences.en: They're lots of work around psychoeducation, understanding why your brain is sometimes giving you really unhelpful conversations going on.
sentences.zh: 这其中包含大量心理教育的工作，去理解为什么你的大脑有时会给你灌输那些毫无帮助的对话。

sentences.en: And then working on how do you change those conversations in your head.
sentences.zh: 然后去研究如何改变你脑海中的这些对话。

sentences.en: We'll be looking a lot at being able to self-advocate better.
sentences.zh: 我们会花很多时间来学习如何更好地为自己发声。

sentences.en: Lots of the self-talk that you're using.
sentences.zh: 包括你所使用的许多自我对话。

sentences.en: Lots of the values and why you might have those fears or those anxieties.
sentences.zh: 探讨你的许多价值观，以及你为什么会有这些恐惧或焦虑。

sentences.en: But you're going to work in line with your values anyway.
sentences.zh: 但无论如何，你的行动都会符合你的价值观。

sentences.en: And then we'll build things like mental skills in.
sentences.zh: 然后我们会建立一些心理技能。

sentences.en: So I think I do a lot with those athletes that have got exams coming up.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得我对那些面临考试的运动员做了很多工作。

sentences.en: Might be something like control mapping.
sentences.zh: 可能会用到像控制图解这样的方法。

sentences.en: What can you control right now?
sentences.zh: 你现在能控制什么？

sentences.en: And what focus can you put on that?
sentences.zh: 你能把注意力集中在什么上面？

sentences.en: What can't you control?
sentences.zh: 什么是你无法控制的？

sentences.zh: 你该如何接受自己无法控制的事实并继续前进？

sentences.zh: 或者像“如果……会怎样”的规划法。

sentences.en: Every single thing you were worried about that could happen.
sentences.zh: 你所担心的每一件可能会发生的事情。

sentences.en: And especially the silly things.
sentences.zh: 尤其是那些看似荒谬的事情。

sentences.en: They always go, there's always a, I know this sounds silly, but it's like, that's what we want on there.
sentences.zh: 他们总是会说，总会有这样一种情况，我知道这听起来很傻，但这正是我们想要列出来的。

sentences.en: And then we put the, well, how are you going to prevent that happening?
sentences.zh: 然后我们会探讨，嗯，你打算如何防止这种情况发生？

sentences.en: What can you do in the next few weeks that means that's less likely to happen?
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几周里，你能做些什么来降低这种事情发生的可能性？

sentences.en: But you know what?
sentences.zh: 但你知道吗？

sentences.zh: 有些事还是可能会发生。

sentences.en: Because it does.
sentences.zh: 因为生活就是这样。

sentences.zh: 这就是生活。

sentences.en: And what are you going to do in that moment?
sentences.zh: 那么在那一刻你打算怎么做？

sentences.en: So that instead of your threat system kicking in and you not being able to think logically, rationally, that you are able to keep that thinking that you want.
sentences.zh: 这样一来，当你的威胁系统启动、让你无法进行逻辑和理性思考时，你依然能够保持你想要的思考方式。

sentences.en: And I would use that exactly the same for someone who's got their first triathlon this weekend
sentences.zh: 这和那些这个周末要迎来第一场铁人三项比赛的人所用的方法完全一样

sentences.en: and is worried about what might be in the water below them when they're in open water swimming.

sentences.en: Through to someone that's got an exam that they're not sure they've done the right training through.
sentences.zh: 一直到那些不确定自己准备充分与否就要考试的学生。

sentences.en: Through to an opera singer that's got their first night coming up.
sentences.zh: 再到即将迎来首演的歌剧演员。

sentences.en: It's just matched to the context of the environment that somebody's in.
sentences.zh: 只是根据个人所处的环境进行了调整而已。

sentences.en: And it's not cheating.
sentences.zh: 这并不是作弊。

sentences.en: It's optimizing and, you know, doing yourself a favor.
sentences.zh: 这是在优化，你知道的，是在对自己好一点。

sentences.en: I mean, the amount of practice that athletes do.
sentences.zh: 我是说，运动员们训练的量有多大啊。

sentences.zh: 所以我跟很多游泳运动员合作。

sentences.zh: 那为什么我不行呢？

sentences.zh: 第三，这会长期搞砸你的生育能力。

sentences.en: So there are many elite athletes who have had to go through IVF for to have their children.
sentences.zh: 所以有很多精英运动员不得不通过试管婴儿（IVF）来孕育下一代。

sentences.en: And many who amateurs and elites who haven't been able to have children.
sentences.zh: 还有许多业余和精英运动员根本无法生育。

sentences.en: So it it was almost seen a while ago, hopefully a while ago, as a badge of honor.
sentences.zh: 所以在一段时间以前，希望是很久以前，这甚至被视为一种荣誉的象征。

sentences.en: You have trained hard enough that you don't get a period.
sentences.zh: 说明你训练足够刻苦，以至于连月经都没有了。

sentences.en: So it's seen as like a wow, that makes you almost elite.
sentences.zh: 所以这被看作是一种“哇，这说明你几乎达到了精英水平”的表现。

sentences.en: And certainly 10, 15 years ago when I first started learning about it, it was definitely that kind of look at me.
sentences.zh: 当然在10、15年前我刚开始了解这个概念时，确实就是那种“快看我”的心态。

sentences.en: I'm good enough.
sentences.zh: 我很优秀。

sentences.en: I don't get a period.
sentences.zh: 我都没有月经。

sentences.en: We now know how harmful that is for you for performance and long term health.
sentences.zh: 我们现在知道了这对你的运动表现和长期健康有多么大的危害。

sentences.en: And it tends to be known as RED-S.
sentences.zh: 这种情况通常被称为RED-S。

sentences.en: So it stands for Relative Energy Deficiency in Sport.
sentences.zh: 它的全称是“运动相对能量不足”（Relative Energy Deficiency in Sport）。

sentences.en: And it's often thought of as an accidental eating disorder.
sentences.zh: 人们通常认为这是一种“意外的饮食失调”。

sentences.en: So you are not actively trying to lose weight to change your body shape.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，你并不是在刻意减重来改变体型。

sentences.en: What most people do is they step up the amount of exercise that they do without matching that with the amount of calories that they need.
sentences.zh: 大多数人的做法是，在增加运动量的同时，却没有摄入与其相匹配的热量。

sentences.en: And so it is often accidental, but sometimes it will be.
sentences.zh: 所以这通常是无意中造成的，但有时也有意为之。

sentences.en: There are still some sports, particularly cycling, running, climbing, where there is this whole culture that lighter is faster.
sentences.zh: 仍然有一些运动项目，特别是自行车、跑步、攀岩，存在着一种“越轻越快”的文化。

sentences.en: And so people will try and drop some weight to get faster.
sentences.zh: 因此人们会试图减重来让自己跑得更快。

sentences.en: And the real problem with it is that that works for a short amount of time.
sentences.zh: 而这其中真正的问题在于，这种方法只在短时间内有效。

sentences.en: So you've still got the strength you've built up, but very quickly you lose some weight and you are then able to go faster using that strength.
sentences.zh: 所以你依然拥有之前积累的力量，但通过迅速减重，你能够借助这股力量跑得更快。

sentences.en: And then you break.
sentences.zh: 然后你就垮了。

sentences.en: So for women, it will be that your period stops.
sentences.zh: 对女性来说，表现为月经停止。

sentences.en: For men, it will be they don't get a morning erection because their testosterone levels have dropped so much.
sentences.zh: 对男性来说，表现为由于睾酮水平大幅下降而不再有晨勃。

sentences.en: And then over time, when that continues, you start to struggle with energy levels.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，这种情况持续下去，你就会开始苦于精力不足。

sentences.en: And the big thing that normally stops people in their tracks is stress fractures.
sentences.zh: 而通常给人们当头一棒、让他们停下脚步的重大问题就是应力性骨折。

sentences.en: Particularly runners, because you are not giving your body the hormones that it needs.
sentences.zh: 特别是跑步者，因为你没有给身体提供它所需的荷尔蒙。

sentences.en: You are starving yourself in a way.
sentences.zh: 从某种意义上说，你在让自己挨饿。

sentences.en: And then you are running up and down on bones that are getting very, very damaged.
sentences.zh: 然后你却在受到严重损伤的骨骼上跑来跑去。

sentences.en: So that that's unhelpful for particularly an elite level, because you cannot progress.
sentences.zh: 所以这对于精英级别来说是毫无帮助的，因为你无法取得进展。

sentences.en: You will then be out for a while.
sentences.zh: 你随后将不得不休息一段时间。

sentences.en: And.
sentences.zh: 而且。

sentences.en: And it's horrible,
sentences.zh: 这太糟糕了，

sentences.en: but I love the fact that quite a few elite runners have been talking about this and they will explain to people that they have had red ass and why it is so dangerous.
sentences.zh: 但我很高兴看到有相当多的精英跑步者开始谈论这件事，他们会向人们解释自己曾患过RED-S以及它为什么如此危险。

sentences.en: And and others celebrate getting their periods back.
sentences.zh: 而且其他人也在庆祝自己月经恢复。

sentences.en: And I've had little period parties with clients where we're like high fiving at the screen because they've got their first period in a few years.
sentences.zh: 我和客户还举办过小型的“月经派对”，我们在屏幕前击掌庆祝，因为她们几年来第一次来了月经。

sentences.en: And it feels really odd, but it's so important.
sentences.zh: 这感觉真的很奇怪，但却极其重要。

sentences.en: And it's about then changing the culture in elite sport.
sentences.zh: 这关乎改变精英体育圈的文化。

sentences.en: That we have to talk about this stuff.
sentences.zh: 我们必须公开谈论这些事情。

sentences.en: And I will talk about it with male coaches when I'm working with an athlete and I talk to their coach and I'm like, do you know whether they get their period?
sentences.zh: 当我与某位运动员合作时，我会和他们的男教练谈论这件事，我跟他们的教练说：“你知道她来月经了吗？”

sentences.en: And I'll be like, oh, can't ask a girl that.
sentences.zh: 他们会说：“哦，这怎么好问女孩子。”

sentences.en: You're like, how do you know if she's healthy enough then to do this training that you're setting?
sentences.zh: 你会觉得：“那你怎么知道她目前的健康状况是否足以承受你安排的这种训练呢？”

sentences.en: We have to make it much more normal to be able to talk about those health markers so that we can make sure somebody is in the best place to do it.
sentences.zh: 我们必须让谈论这些健康指标变得更加稀松平常，这样我们才能确保一个人处于进行训练的最佳状态。

sentences.en: And we will we don't really want someone training particularly hard.
sentences.zh: 我们其实并不希望有人进行强度特别大的训练。

sentences.en: We'll cap what training somebody is doing at quite a low heart rate until they've had three periods back.
sentences.zh: 在她们恢复三次月经之前，我们会将训练心率限制在相当低的水平。

sentences.en: And so it's it's not just about stepping up the eating.
sentences.zh: 所以这不仅仅是多吃一点那么简单。

sentences.en: It can be probably a six to 12 month process of getting healthy again.
sentences.zh: 这可能需要6到12个月的过程才能恢复健康。

sentences.en: So for elites, that's a year out of their career.
sentences.zh: 对精英运动员来说，这意味着职业生涯中有一年时间处于空白期。

sentences.en: We absolutely don't want them getting into that state.
sentences.zh: 我们绝对不希望他们陷入那种状态。

sentences.en: But for for regular amateurs, too, that takes so much joy away from what you do.
sentences.zh: 但对普通业余爱好者来说也是如此，这会夺走你运动本身的许多乐趣。

sentences.en: And the big thing is it tends to curtail your social life because many of us get into our sport and then we join a club.
sentences.zh: 最主要的是，这往往会缩减你的社交生活，因为我们许多人投身某项运动，然后加入一个俱乐部。

sentences.en: And that's how we get lots of our excitement and we go on training camps together and then suddenly your sense of belonging goes because you don't feel like you belong to that that group.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们获得许多激情的方式，我们一起去训练营，然后突然之间，由于你不再觉得自己属于那个群体，你的归属感就消失了。

sentences.en: It's really harsh.
sentences.zh: 这真的很残酷。

sentences.en: So I think we need to talk about it much, much more.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为我们需要更多更多地谈论这个话题。

sentences.en: And if you've got clients who are saying, oh, but elites are allowed to do this, they're not.
sentences.zh: 如果你有客户说：“哦，但精英运动员可以这样啊”，他们其实不可以。

sentences.en: And more and more is being put in place to stop that.
sentences.zh: 而且现在有越来越多的人开始采取措施来阻止这种情况发生。

sentences.en: Great.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for eliminating that for myself and for our audience as well.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你为我和我们的听众解开了这个谜团。

sentences.en: And it's really important stuff to hold on to that we're we're talking about with our clients.
sentences.zh: 这些都是非常重要的观点，我们要牢记在心，并在与客户交流时谈论它们。

sentences.en: So your most recent book, baby, I think it's your most recent, is called The Ten Pillars.
sentences.zh: 所以你的最近一本著作，宝贝，我想应该是最近的一本，叫做《十大支柱》。

sentences.en: And I'm currently listening to it on Audible and your voice is just amazing.
sentences.zh: 我目前正在Audible上听这本书，你的声音简直太棒了。

sentences.en: I'm loving it.
sentences.zh: 我太喜欢了。

sentences.en: And you've got a little bit of music.
sentences.zh: 里面还有一点音乐。

sentences.en: I can't listen to it.
sentences.zh: 我听不了。

sentences.en: Oh, I love the music bits.
sentences.zh: 哦，我很喜欢音乐部分。

sentences.en: That's the best part of writing an Audible book is that when you've recorded everything,
sentences.zh: 录制Audible有声书最棒的部分就是，当你把所有内容都录完后，

sentences.en: they've got the most amazing database of every single piece of music you could ever imagine.
sentences.zh: 他们拥有你所能想象到的每一首单曲的最惊人的数据库。

sentences.en: And you get to kind of go, I really like piano and this and happiness.
sentences.zh: 然后你就可以说，我真的很喜欢钢琴和这类音乐，还有快乐的感觉。

sentences.en: And they'll type it in and then you just get thousands of pieces of music to pick from and choose and play it in the background.
sentences.zh: 他们把这些输入进去，然后你就能从成千上万首音乐中挑选、选择，并在背景中播放。

sentences.en: It's like the most fun I've had in years.
sentences.zh: 这简直是我多年来玩得最开心的一次。

sentences.en: It's really fun.
sentences.zh: 真的很有趣。

sentences.en: It's really fun.
sentences.zh: 真的很有趣。

sentences.en: And I think it's the only other audio book other than Will Smith's.
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得，除了威尔·史密斯的书之外，这是我听过的唯一另一本有声书。

sentences.en: I don't know if you've ever listened to his on audio book.
sentences.zh: 我不知道你有没有听过他的有声书。

sentences.en: His audio book is amazing because he like raps in it.
sentences.zh: 他的有声书太棒了，因为他在里面会说唱。

sentences.en: He's got music in it.
sentences.zh: 里面有音乐。

sentences.en: He's got background.
sentences.zh: 还有背景音。

sentences.en: And it's like it's such a good audio book to listen to.
sentences.zh: 感觉这是一本非常棒、非常适合听的有声书。

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: It's also written, ghostwritten, I think, by Mark Manson, who has written.
sentences.zh: 而且这本书也是由代笔人写的，我想是马克·曼森，他写过……

sentences.en: Oh, is it?
sentences.zh: 哦，是吗？

sentences.en: I didn't realise it'd been ghostwritten.
sentences.zh: 我没意识到这是由别人代笔的。

sentences.en: I thought he'd just done it all himself rather well.
sentences.zh: 我还以为全都是他自己完成的，而且写得相当好呢。

sentences.en: No, no, no, no.
sentences.zh: 不，不，不，不。

sentences.en: He's written some fascinating psychology books, particularly around relationships, where, again, in his books, he's almost, it's kind of half podcast,
sentences.zh: 他写过一些非常吸引人的心理学书籍，特别是关于人际关系的，在这些书中，它几乎有点像半个播客，

sentences.en: where he's interviewed and worked with clients about their sexual, their relationship kind of histories and backgrounds as he coaches them through.
sentences.zh: 他在节目中采访并配合客户，了解他们的性经历、人际关系史和背景，并在指导他们的过程中提供帮助。

sentences.en: And so I was listening to Will Smith's book, loving it, but going, this is very well written by an actor.
sentences.zh: 所以当时我在听威尔·史密斯的书，非常喜欢，但心里想，这本书由一个演员来写，写得可真好啊。

sentences.en: I did think it was very well written.
sentences.zh: 我确实觉得它写得很好。

sentences.en: And then having seen the more recent, you know, goings on at the Oscars, I thought, oh, there's a slight mismatch here, maybe.
sentences.zh: 然后看到最近奥斯卡颁奖典礼上的种种风波，我就想，哦，这里面可能有点轻微的不匹配。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: But I thought from a psychological perspective, he just got the psychology of things.
sentences.zh: 但我认为从心理学的角度来看，他完全懂其中的心理机制。

sentences.en: And I was like listening to it going, there's so many lessons in here about mindset and behaviours and ways to go out and achieve great performance.
sentences.zh: 我当时一边听一边想，这里面有太多关于心态、行为以及如何去追求卓越表现的经验教训了。

sentences.en: And I think the ghostwriter really cleverly pulled those out because it was almost like I wanted to circle the audio book of going, oh, but this bit, this bit's brilliant.
sentences.zh: 我觉得代笔作家非常巧妙地把这些提炼出来了，因为我几乎想给这本有声书做个标记，心想，哦，不过这段，这段太精彩了。

sentences.en: So Will's book's good, but yours is also very good.
sentences.zh: 所以威尔的书很不错，但你的书也非常棒。

sentences.en: And one of the, I'm quite early on in it, but I am loving it.
sentences.zh: 而且我才刚听了一点，但我已经爱不释手了。

sentences.en: You interviewed Dame Kelly Holmes.
sentences.zh: 你采访了戴姆·凯利·霍姆斯。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And I think one of the bits that's particularly relevant for our current aspiring psychologist
sentences.zh: 我觉得其中特别切合我们目前那些有志成为心理学家听众的部分是，

sentences.en: audience is when she's talking about individual pursuits, but also the importance of the team approach.
sentences.zh: 当她谈到个人追求，以及团队合作方法的重要性时。

sentences.en: And I know, I think there was a quite high profile, it might have been gymnast who was booted off the team for being too self-focused.
sentences.zh: 我知道，好像有一个备受关注的例子，可能是一位体操运动员因为过于以自我为中心而被踢出了团队。

sentences.en: And she was like, but it's an individual sport.
sentences.zh: 她当时觉得，但这毕竟是一项个人运动。

sentences.en: I don't know why it matters.
sentences.zh: 我不知道这有什么大不了的。

sentences.en: But Dame Kelly is saying, well, it does matter.
sentences.zh: 但戴姆·凯利却说，这确实很重要。

sentences.en: And actually, the ability to think about others in your team and others in your industry, not necessarily as competition, but as an asset.
sentences.zh: 事实上，能够把团队里的其他人以及你所在行业里的其他人看作是一种资产，而不仅仅是竞争对手的能力，

sentences.en: I really liked what you were saying about that.
sentences.zh: 我真的很喜欢你对此所说的话。

sentences.en: Could you illuminate us in that area?
sentences.zh: 你能为我们在这一领域指点迷津吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: When I do my intro sessions with new clients, I'll always ask, who's on your team?
sentences.zh: 当我与新客户进行初次交流时，我总是会问，谁是你的团队成员？

sentences.en: And most of my clients, to be honest, are individual sports.
sentences.zh: 说实话，我的大多数客户从事的都是个人项目。

sentences.en: And they're like, well, I do an individual sport.
sentences.zh: 他们会说，我参加的是个人运动。

sentences.en: And I'm like, no, I know, but who's on your team?
sentences.zh: 然后我会说，不，我明白，但谁是你的团队？

sentences.en: Who's on your side?
sentences.zh: 谁站在你这边？

sentences.en: Who's got your back?
sentences.zh: 谁在为你撑腰？

sentences.en: Who are the people you go to when you're having a bad day, when you need to ask something about training, when something hurts, when you're feeling sad?
sentences.zh: 当你度过糟糕的一天、需要询问训练相关问题、身体某个部位疼痛、或者感到难过时，你会去找哪些人？

sentences.en: And we'll really pull out kind of who is on their side.
sentences.zh: 我们会真正地梳理出到底是谁站在他们这一边。

sentences.en: So many of them will have a coach.
sentences.zh: 他们中的很多人都会有一个教练。

sentences.en: But it's like, oh, but I've got Fred at training.
sentences.zh: 但往往是，哦，不过我在训练时认识了弗雷德。

sentences.en: And Fred always is a really good giggle.
sentences.zh: 弗雷德总是能带来很多欢乐。

sentences.en: And oh, yeah, I've got a physio.
sentences.zh: 哦，对了，我还有一个理疗师。

sentences.en: I go and see if this thing's wrong.
sentences.zh: 如果身体哪里不对劲，我就会去找他看一看。

sentences.en: And yeah, there's a teacher at school who really seems to get me.
sentences.zh: 还有，学校里有个老师真的很懂我。

sentences.en: And we really pull out, what are you part of?
sentences.zh: 我们真正探讨的是，你属于什么群体？

sentences.en: And I think that's really helpful.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这真的很有帮助。

sentences.en: And Kelly brought this home beautifully in a really sad section of the interview that I did with her, where she talked about in 2004, she was training with an athlete from another
sentences.zh: 凯利在我的采访中，通过一个非常令人痛心的片段，把这一点淋漓尽致地展现了出来。她谈到在2004年，她和来自另一个国家的运动员以及他们的教练一起训练。

sentences.en: country and her coach.
sentences.zh: 教练同时带了他们两个。

sentences.en: And the coach had both of them.
sentences.zh: 她觉得教练并没有全力支持她。

sentences.en: And she didn't feel like the coach had her back.
sentences.zh: 她觉得另一个运动员才是头号种子。

sentences.en: She felt like this other athlete was the number one athlete.
sentences.zh: 而她只是在其中勉强凑数。

sentences.en: And she was kind of slotting in.
sentences.zh: 她感到非常非常痛苦。

sentences.en: And she was really, really miserable.
sentences.zh: 她甚至开始自残。

sentences.en: She was self-harming.
sentences.zh: 她说自己当时突然意识到，我不属于这里。

sentences.en: And she said she had this realization that I don't belong here.
sentences.zh: 这就是我自残的原因。

sentences.en: And that's why I'm self-harming.
sentences.zh: 这就是我试图寻找某种方式去感受存在的原因。

sentences.en: That's why I'm trying to find a way to feel something.
sentences.zh: 于是她换了教练。

sentences.en: And she changed coach.
sentences.zh: 她加入了英国国家队的训练体系。

sentences.en: She joined the GB setup.
sentences.zh: 她和其他英国队的运动员一起去参加训练营。

sentences.en: And she went out to training camps with the other GB athletes.
sentences.zh: 她说这给她带来了巨大的改变。

sentences.en: She said that was such a huge change for her.
sentences.zh: 她有了定期进行沟通的英国队理疗师。

sentences.en: So she had the GB physio that she was checking in with regularly.
sentences.zh: 她有了一个全力支持她的教练。

sentences.en: She had a coach that was on her side.
sentences.zh: 也就是在那一年，她赢得了两枚奥运金牌。

sentences.en: And that was the year she won two Olympic gold medals.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得，这背后其实还有更多丰富的内容。

sentences.en: And so I just thought that was, there's so much more behind it.
sentences.zh: 但这也成为了她的标志。

sentences.en: But it's become her thing.
